newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Kemayan to buy land.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Kemayan to buy land.

text.p: Malaysia's Kemayan Corp Bhd said on Wednesday that its Kemayan Land Sdn Bhd unit has entered into an agreement to buy four pices of commercial land in southern Johor state for a total of 109.39 million ringgit.
In a statement, Kemayan said the land, totalling 1.37 million square feet, would be developed into a commercial complex, a transit system complex and a technical college.
The project will be undertaken in four phases over a period of 10 years.

Under the agreement with the landowners, who are five unlisted companies, Kemayan said the payment would be satisfied by 47.56 million new Kemayan shares of 50 cents each at a proposed price of 2.30 ringgit per share.
It said the acquisition is in line with its core business in property development.
As a result of the acquisition, its share capital will rise to 717.82 million from 670.26 million and its net tangible asset per share to 1.35 ringgit from 1.28 ringgit.
